title: Context-aware microbatcher: per-customer temporal profiling and safe-apply rollback plan
creator: Carlos Vega
description: Build a context-aware microbatching recommendation and continuous tuning subsystem that profiles request streams at the tenant and route level, emits heuristics for batching/window sizing and KV-cache hints, and supports safe rollout with shadow-apply, canaries, and automated rollback triggers. This ticket covers telemetry collection, heuristic design, simulator-driven validation, control-plane APIs for suggested batch configs, console UX hooks, and a conservative safe-apply flow integrated with the runtime fallback policies.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry pipeline produces per-tenant temporal profiles (p95 inter-arrival, session windows, request size histogram) for at least 90% of active routes
Microbatcher heuristics API returns suggested configs (max_batch_tokens, max_batch_latency_ms, route_coalescing_window_ms, kv_cache_scope) with confidence scores
Simulator replays sampled traffic and demonstrates >=12% median token-cost reduction and <5% tail-latency increase for suggested configs on held-out workloads
Safe-apply rollout can push a batching config in shadow mode, run a canary on 1% of traffic, and automatically rollback if defined metrics breach thresholds
Console shows per-route recommendation, expected cost delta, risk estimate, and a one-click apply that follows the safe-apply workflow
Automated tests cover heuristics unit logic, simulator end-to-end validation, and rollback trigger firing in CI
rollout_plan: Step 0: Feature flag gated behind microbatcher-v1
Step 1: Telemetry collection enabled in shadow mode for 2 weeks to build profiles
Step 2: Off-line simulator runs candidate configs against stored traces and produces recommended configs with confidence
Step 3: Console surfaces recommendations; PM/SE review required for high-impact routes
Step 4: Apply as shadow-config (no effect on live routing) for 48 hours to validate system behavior
Step 5: Canary apply to 1% of traffic with enhanced tracing and rate-limited scaling
Step 6: Monitor cost delta, tail latency (p99), error rate, and downstream tokenization regressions for 72 hours
Step 7: If stable, progressively increase to 10% then 50% via automated staged rollout with human approval for >50%
Step 8: Full apply with post-apply monitoring and a 24h automatic rollback window
rollback_triggers: p99 latency increases by >20% relative to baseline for the canary cohort
error rate (5xx or model decode failures) increases by absolute >0.2%
observed token-count vs expected token-count mismatch >10% indicating tokenizer/regression issues
any customer SLA-linked route reports a user-facing incident via PagerDuty
simulator confidence score drops below 0.5 after shadow period
test_plan: Unit tests for heuristics (edge cases: single-request spikes, bursty tails, idle sessions)
Integration tests that validate control-plane apply/rollback and feature-flag gating
Simulator regression suite with sampled traces from prod (anonymized) covering small, medium, large tenants
Load test showing autoscaling interactions with batch windows under saturating traffic
E2E test that verifies console recommendation -> apply workflow and UI indicators
